guardMeaning: Constant minimum free-space floor = 2.5 GiB plus 4 MiB safety margin; must hold continuously, with at least one live owned-process/total-disk check every 0.25 seconds.

helperIdentity.sideEffectsForFutureRun: One explicit output file plus POST/PUT/GET against only the explicitly supplied loopback scratch URL; no source checkout, provider-runtime fixture write, credential access, or command execution of RCC.
helperIdentity.sourceBehavior: Creates an unsigned, empty NewRevocationBundleAt fixture timestamp, writes only the explicitly supplied output path, PUTs bytes to the supplied HTTP carrier, reads back and verifies exact bytes/digest/empty contents, then emits a JSON receipt. The planned call is restricted to a new owned scratch provider root. No key/signing operation or write to the historical provider/carrier.

historicalAllocationEvidence.estimateCaveat: Conservative allocation estimate, not measured historical du/blocks. It omits filesystem metadata/journal and any copy-on-write overhead, so actual requirement could be higher. Archive had zero hardlink members; compressed archive byte size is not restored-home allocation evidence.
historicalAllocationEvidence.headerOnlyInspection: Read gzip tar headers only with Python tarfile; no member extraction and no foreign-home reads.
historicalAllocationEvidence.priorReceiptCounts: Preservation receipt reports 32,330 entries; 15,562 regular files; 1,156 symlinks; hash/type/mode membership verification, but no allocated blocks or hardlink counts.

liveRuntimeGuardForAnyFutureAdmission.requiredActions: On every 0.25s sample enforce total workspace free >= guard, aggregate owned-process RSS <= limit, owned scratch <= limit; on breach record SIGTERM numeric exit, verify no owned descendants remain (process-tree snapshot and /proc references), then stop. Do not cleanup evidence or any non-owned process.

noAction: PLAN ONLY. Await explicit root admission; do not create homes, keys, snapshots, providers, copy/execute the candidate, alter the original frozen plan, or change Actions.
outputRetention: Future receipt should use compact per-object digest,size records, preserve raw command outputs within the predeclared 4 MiB cap, and hash provider fixture before/after. Any actual 5,049 CAS objects must be individually rehashed by the root verifier; no oversized verbose duplicate inventory.

requiredMinimumCapacityForProposedFreshH.decision: Does not fit current free space or 330,000,000-byte scratch cap. Do not start the run. A different approved resource strategy/capacity is needed.

sourceIdentity.strictPolicy: Read-only inspection confirms StrictRemote still fail-closed and default fresh revocation age is 24h; this test uses only a fresh unsigned empty fixture snapshot, not publisher/revocation authority evidence.
